title: Histiocytic Disorder Follow-up Study
summary: The purpose of the study is to describe the burden of chronic health conditions, psychological dysfunction, chronic pain, healthcare utilization, worse health-related quality of life, overall mortality, and cause-specific mortality among individuals with histiocytic disorders
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of histiocytic disorder at any age

  1. Langerhans cell histiocytosis,
  2. Erdheim-Chester disease,
  3. Rosai-Dorfman disease,
  4. Xanthogranuloma,
  5. Mixed histiocytosis
  6. Malignant histiocytosis (Histiocytic sarcoma, langerhans cell sarcoma, interdigitating cell sarcoma)
  7. Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
